description: List all collections OR get a specific collection with its items. Without id: returns all collections with counts/values. With id: returns that collection's metadata and all items inside (with optional filters).

created_by.description: Filter by who added: "ai" for AI-added items (only when id is provided)

id.description: Collection ID — if provided, returns that collection with all its items. If omitted, lists all collections.

max_price.description: Maximum price filter (only when id is provided)

min_price.description: Minimum price filter (only when id is provided)

platform.description: Filter by platform domain name, e.g. "amazon", "ebay" (only when id is provided)

sort.description: Sort order (only when id is provided, default: newest)

status.description: Filter by decision status (only when id is provided)

tags.description: Filter items that have ALL these tags (only when id is provided)

name: list_collections
